author: PokerFace
body:
I think Avicus is good for what it has but it can be better if it has more. I recall that during McZone there were many players. WHY? There were survival games, sky wars, parkour. I remember there were 8 different games. The only ones actually being played are Nebula, Nexus, and sometimes CTH. I suggest that the old games be brought back and if you want to keep avicade that you add more games to it. Maybe you could incorporate the parkour that you guys said was "coming soon" into avicade. I have been waiting more than 1 year for that parkour and everyday that there isn't one makes me sadder everyday. I also suggest that if you want to make the server stand out, that you let players choose teams for walls so that you can team with your friends. I do not think you should pay for an option such as this.

-Thank you for taking the time to read this owners of Avicus. I hope my ideas will help bring better success for the future of Avicus.
-PokerFace_Legend
